        Inventory Web Services
    
    
         
                Collapse All
                Expand All
            
        View with Navigation Tools
    
    
    
    
    
        The following web services are all related to the Inventory functional area of the application:






    
        
            Web Service

            Description
        

        
            Cancel Inventory Transactions

            Cancels the already performed inventory transactions
        

        
            Cycle Count Plan

            Allows access to a Cycle Count Plan.
        

        
            Cycle Count Quick Plan

            Queues a list of Cycle Count Quick Plan for processing or calculates how many cycle count requests would be created for the quick plan.
        

        
            Inventory

            Allows access to links (URL or URI template) to web services related to inventory.
        

        
            Inventory Override Info

            Gets the Check Digit, Location Verification Method and inventory information associated with a Location.
        

        
            Inventory Transactions

            Prepares inventory for work and create work. This is used for transaction inventory adjustment or transfer with work only.
        

        
            Short Pick Replenishment

            Tries to avoid short pick by replenishing the location before short pick happens.
